intent: Keep Havenwild code/editor/runtime proprietary while satisfying per-artwork licenses.

policies.CC0-1.0: green; attribution retained voluntarily for provenance
policies.CC-BY-3.0: green_conditional; attribution/change notice and distribution review required
policies.CC-BY-4.0: green_conditional; attribution/change notice and distribution review required
policies.CC-BY-SA-3.0: yellow; commercial/closed-source code allowed but derivative artwork keeps ShareAlike obligations
policies.CC-BY-SA-4.0: yellow; commercial/closed-source code allowed but derivative artwork keeps ShareAlike obligations

multiLicenseRule: Select one offered license deliberately; prefer CC0/OGA-BY when offered as alternatives.
releaseGate: all used assets have verified provenance
no red/unknown asset is referenced by production manifests
credits generated from exact used assets
ShareAlike derivative package generated where required
disclaimer: Project policy and automation guidance; not legal advice.
